summary.answer: Accept num with no explicit receiver requirement. Coerce num through int first. If level.createfxexploders and its num entry are both defined, iterate i from 0 while i is less than the current entry size and invoke activate_individual_exploder synchronously on each indexed entry. The lightning predicate is evaluated independently after that loop, including when the array guard fails. Only a truthy exploder_is_lightning_exploder(num) plus both defined lightning pointers starts a new fx::lightning thread with those two pointers as arguments. No payload is returned. summary.answer: Accept string, without checking its type or definition. If level.var_13a6af33 is defined, invoke that stored pointer synchronously with string and no explicit receiver. After it returns, loop localclientnum from 0 while below current level.localplayers.size and call native playradiantexploder(localclientnum,string). The loop passes client indexes rather than reading player entries. An undefined pointer skips only the callback. Missing/invalid localplayers, noncallable pointers, callback errors or callback changes to the later loop inputs have no local recovery. No explicit return payload.
